findings.title: Rapid7 MDR Team Discovers New SonicWall SMA1000 Zero Days being Actively Exploited (CVE-2026-15409, CVE-2026-15410)
findings.summary_md: Rapid7's Managed Detection and Response team observed active exploitation of CVE-2026-15409 and CVE-2026-15410 against internet-facing SonicWall SMA1000 appliances before official disclosure. The post details the unauthenticated SSRF via /wsproxy, command execution through the Erlang process on localhost:1050, and the local privilege escalation via CVE-2026-15410. Fixed versions include 12.4.3-03453 and 12.5.0-02835 platform hotfixes. Active exploitation was noted in SonicWall's advisory and both CVEs were added to CISA's KEV catalog.

findings.title: Cyber attack detected during PCC election count
findings.summary_md: The Borough Council of King's Lynn and West Norfolk detected a cyberattack on 17 July 2026 that affected council services. The incident occurred during vote counting for a police and crime commissioner by-election. Officials reported it to the NCSC, temporarily restricted telephone and website services, and stated no data was accessed or stolen. The election was not hampered and normal services resumed by the next day.
